description:
Intetics Inc., a leading American technology company specializing in custom software application development, distributed professional teams creation, software product quality assessment, and “all-things-digital” solutions, is looking for a Back-end Developer to join our team.

Long-term cooperation on an as-needed basis, with potential part-time assignments and travel to the client’s office if required

Our client is an international organization supporting global environmental and sustainability initiatives. The engagement focuses on developing and supporting enterprise applications, digital services, and technology solutions used across the organization. Specialists will collaborate with internal teams and external partners in an international environment, following established architecture, security, and delivery standards.

We are looking for an M365 Developer / Engineer to build and integrate solutions across the Microsoft 365 ecosystem. The role combines .NET development with Power Platform capabilities to deliver secure, scalable applications and integrations supporting business processes and collaboration.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain backend services, business logic, APIs, and application components using .NET and C#.
  • Build integrations with Microsoft 365 services, including SharePoint and Teams.
  • Integrate custom-developed components with Power Apps and Power Automate.
  • Combine traditional development and low-code capabilities in line with architectural standards.
  • Implement user stories and acceptance criteria alongside Business Analysts, architects, frontend developers, and low-code developers.
  • Develop unit tests, participate in code reviews, resolve defects, and maintain technical and integration documentation.
  • At least 5 years of experience in software and application development.
  • At least 3 years of hands-on development experience within the Microsoft 365 ecosystem.
  • At least 3 years of experience developing backend services, APIs, or application components using .NET and C#.
  • Experience integrating .NET solutions with Microsoft 365 and Power Platform.
  • Experience with data ingestion, transformation, and preparation across multiple sources.
  • Experience translating business requirements into data models, measures, reports, or analytical outputs.
  • Experience with unit testing, code reviews, version control, and Jira.
  • Bachelor’s degree or higher.
  • At least one relevant certification: PL-400, AZ-204, PL-600, or equivalent.

Would be a plus:

  • For university degrees, the awarding institution must rank among the top 500 in an overall or subject-specific university ranking
  • Experience working with or for large organizations with complex structures and multiple business units
